Definition: The first militant of the Algerian War of Independence to be executed

Definition: A prominent leader of the Algerian resistance against French colonialism

Name: Frantz Fanon
Definition: Psychiatrist and revolutionary philosopher who supported the FLN

Name: Emir Abdelkader
Definition: The founder of the modern Algerian state and a leader of resistance

Definition: Mathematics activist who fought for the Algerian cause alongside her husband

Definition: The document announcing the start of the revolution

Definition: The meeting that organized the political and military structure of FLN

Definition: The day Algeria officially gained sovereignty from France
